evals.name: basic-setup-toolbar
evals.prompt: I want to add Velt's 'who viewed this document today' badge to my Next.js app's toolbar. What's the simplest setup?
evals.expected_output: Place <VeltViewAnalytics/> in the toolbar. Imported from @veltdev/react. Should mention assuming VeltProvider + document already configured. Should NOT recommend useUsersOnDocument/presence/Vercel-KV/webhook workarounds.

evals.name: location-scoped-trigger
evals.prompt: My Velt document has multiple tabs. I want the View Analytics badge to count views per-tab, not for the whole document. How do I scope it to the currently-active tab (id 'tab-3')?
evals.expected_output: Pass type='location' AND location-id='tab-3' on <VeltViewAnalytics>. Should explain that location-id alone doesn't work without type='location'.

evals.name: react-hook-viewers-count
evals.prompt: I want to render a custom badge that just shows the count of unique viewers today — no Velt default UI. What React hook should I use, and how do I get the count?
evals.expected_output: Use useUniqueViewsByUser() from @veltdev/react. Count is .length on the returned array (null-guard for first render). Should note no <VeltViewAnalytics> needed for hook-only path.

evals.name: vanilla-js-observable
evals.prompt: I'm not using React. From plain JS, how do I subscribe to the unique views by date for my Velt document and log them? Show the exact API call.
evals.expected_output: client.getViewsElement().getUniqueViewsByDate().subscribe(...). PLURAL getViewsElement. Manual unsubscribe(). Optional locationId arg. Should NOT call getViewElement (singular).

evals.name: custom-trigger-wireframe
evals.prompt: I want a fully custom 'Viewed today' button — my own styling, my own count, my own click behavior — but still backed by Velt's view-analytics data. Which wireframe tag, and which componentConfig variable holds the count?
evals.expected_output: Use <VeltViewAnalyticsWireframe> (or <velt-view-analytics-wireframe>). Count: componentConfig.todayViewsCount. Bind via <velt-data field='componentConfig.todayViewsCount'>. Should NOT recommend the dialog wireframe.

evals.name: dialog-viewer-list-wireframe
evals.prompt: I want a custom recent-viewers list inside the View Analytics dialog popover — instead of Velt's default styling. Which wireframe tag do I customize, and which componentConfig variable gives me the sorted list of viewers?
evals.expected_output: Use <VeltViewAnalyticsDialogWireframe> (or <velt-view-analytics-dialog-wireframe>). Variable: componentConfig.userViews (sorted { user, timestamp }[]). Access fields like componentConfig.userViews.0.user.name. componentConfig.userViews.length for count.

evals.name: treads-visible-spelling
evals.prompt: I want to toggle a CSS class on my custom Velt view-analytics trigger whenever the dialog is open. I tried `velt-class="'open': {componentConfig.threadsVisible}"` but it's not working. What's wrong?
evals.expected_output: The correct variable is componentConfig.treadsVisible (legacy SDK spelling — TREADS, not threads). Should also note flat-config requires the componentConfig. prefix.
